units.source_text: 信辅的家里可以说很是贫穷。

en.t: Shinsuke's family could fairly be called very poor.

units.source_text: 但是，他们的贫穷不是杂居在大杂院里的下层阶级的贫穷，

en.t: But their poverty was not the poverty of the lower classes crowded together in a tenement yard,

units.source_text: 而是为了外表体面而不得不忍受更多的痛苦的中下层阶级的贫穷。

en.t: but rather the poverty of the lower middle class, forced to endure greater suffering for the sake of outward respectability.

units.source_text: 他的父亲从前是官吏，如今已经退休，

en.t: His father had once been a government official, but had now retired,

units.source_text: 不包括那一点存款利息在内，他们一家四口加上女佣，

en.t: and apart from a small amount of interest on their savings, the four members of the family plus a maid,

units.source_text: 五个人，就指望一年五百圆的养老金维持生计。

en.t: five people in all, depended on an annual pension of five hundred yen to get by.
So they had to practice thrift upon thrift.

units.source_text: 他们住在一栋有小庭院的屋子里，包括玄关在内总共只有五个房间。

en.t: They lived in a house with a small garden, but it had only five rooms in all, including the entrance hall.

units.source_text: 家里人几乎很难穿上一件新衣服。

en.t: The people in the household could hardly ever put on a new piece of clothing.

units.source_text: 父亲每晚总是以喝一杯粗酒——一种拿不到台面上的酒——当做消遣。

en.t: Every night his father took as his pleasure a single cup of rough liquor, the sort of drink one could not serve in company.

units.source_text: 母亲也以外面披上和服外褂来掩藏里面布满补丁的腰带。

en.t: His mother, too, would throw a haori over her kimono to hide the patched sash underneath.

units.source_text: 而信辅，他直到如今都记得那张带着油漆臭味的书桌。

en.t: As for Shinsuke, even now he remembered that desk with its smell of paint.

units.source_text: 书桌是中古货，桌面上贴着绿色的绒布，

en.t: The desk was secondhand, with green woolen cloth pasted over its top,

units.source_text: 抽屉的拉把手闪着银色的金属光泽，猛一看你还挺漂亮的。

en.t: and the drawer pulls shone with a silvery metallic gleam, so that at first glance it looked rather pretty.

units.source_text: 实际上，绒布很薄，抽屉也很难拉开。

en.t: In reality, the cloth was very thin, and the drawers were hard to pull open.

units.source_text: 与其说这是他的书桌，毋宁说这是他家的象征。

en.t: Rather than calling it his desk, it would be better to call it the symbol of his family.

units.source_text: 象征着他家那种为了顾及体面而过的更加痛苦的生活……

en.t: It symbolized the still more painful life his family led for the sake of preserving appearances...
